proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ _ f x
  have hcard : (Fintype.card G : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have e : ∑ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, (∑ y, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ y)) * ψ x = ∑ y, f y * ∑ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, ψ (x - y) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ψ _ => ?_))
    rw [mul_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, AddChar.map_neg_eq_conj, mul_comm (ψ x)]
  rw [e]
  simp only [AddChar.sum_apply_eq_ite, sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (f : G → ℂ) (x : G), f x = (Fintype.card G : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, (∑ y, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ y)) * ψ x
